front.title: The ipn.arpa Zone and IPN DNS Operations

abstract.t: This document requests the creation of ipn.arpa, an infrastructure DNS namespace for the Bundle Protocol (BP). It maps a Fully Qualified Node Number to the DNS base name N.A.ipn.arpa., where N is the Node Number and A is the Allocator Identifier. A BP Agent can use that name to discover a convergence-layer endpoint at the destination or at a relay. This document specifies an SRV binding for version 4 of the TCP Convergence-Layer Protocol (TCPCLv4).
